other_failure_modes.name: Random Validation Split for Time Series
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to perform a time-based validation split, but accidentally drops the datetime column during feature engineering. This causes the script to fall back to a random train/test split, which breaks temporal causality and causes severe data leakage in time-series forecasting.

other_failure_modes.name: Train/Test Feature Distribution Shift
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses historical (actual) weather data for training and forecast weather data for testing. This introduces a distribution shift because forecast data contains prediction errors not present in historical data, which will degrade model performance. The model should ideally be trained on forecast data if it will be evaluated on forecast data.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid pipeline with LightGBM, feature engineering, and proper retraining on the full dataset. However, a critical bug during feature engineering drops the datetime column, forcing the validation strategy to fall back to a random split, which causes severe temporal leakage. Additionally, the agent introduces a train/test feature distribution shift by using historical weather for training but forecast weather for testing, and computes frequency encodings before the validation split.
